nodes.label: TREA-01
nodes.rationale: Fictional Earth observation satellite that serves as the core subject of the mission simulation platform. Used in task planning, orbit maneuver, imaging simulation, and collision avoidance scenarios.

nodes.label: treaMissionStore
nodes.rationale: Central Zustand store managing TREA-01 mission simulation state including TLE, fuel, battery, attitude, mission phases, collision alerts, avoidance plans, and maneuver animation.

nodes.label: useCesium
nodes.rationale: Main Cesium hook for the primary globe view. Handles satellite rendering, orbit trails, TREA-01 mission entities, imaging footprints, maneuver visualization, scan beams, AOI highlighting, and camera actions.

nodes.label: useChaseViewer
nodes.rationale: Independent Cesium implementation for /cockpit chase view. Uses direct Model primitives instead of Entity system to avoid jitter and disappearance in continuous render mode.

properties.design_rationale: Entity system has unstable position updates in continuous render mode causing model disappearance and jitter

nodes.label: traffic-sats
nodes.rationale: Core logic for synthetic traffic satellite generation and scripted rendezvous. Used by both useChaseViewer and sim-traffic-scheduling.mjs.

nodes.label: CesiumGlobe
nodes.rationale: Main 3D globe component connecting useCesium hook to React props. Handles mission mode, maneuver events, satellite tracking, and click interaction.

nodes.label: TelemetryDashboard
nodes.rationale: 8-card neon-style telemetry dashboard shared by both HomePage mission mode and ChaseCockpit. Displays position, velocity, attitude, fuel, battery, payload, link quality, and alerts.

nodes.label: CollisionAlertModal
nodes.rationale: Complex state machine component for collision avoidance. Manages the emergency maneuver flow from alert through plan selection, execution, maneuvering, video playback, and success.

nodes.label: HomePage
nodes.rationale: Main application page that orchestrates mission mode, satellite list, search, TLE refresh, image upload, and TREA-01 mission panels.

nodes.label: ChaseCockpit
nodes.rationale: Main /cockpit route component. Combines useChaseViewer hook, TelemetryDashboard, and TREA-01 wireframe image for first-person racing view.

nodes.label: AI Task Planning API
nodes.rationale: AI proxy API route that forwards requests to Volcano Engine Ark (Doubao LLM). Supports two scenarios: task-planning and collision-avoidance.

nodes.label: sim-traffic-scheduling.mjs
nodes.rationale: Simulation/validation script for traffic satellite scheduling logic. Verifies arrival intervals and closest approach distances at 10x rate over 20 minutes.

nodes.label: deploy.sh
nodes.rationale: One-click deployment script for HK server. Auto-generates .env with random Postgres password, checks ACME_EMAIL and LLM_API_KEY, and runs docker compose up.

nodes.label: docker-compose.yml
nodes.rationale: Docker Compose configuration with four services: postgres, migrate (one-time seed), app (Next.js standalone), and caddy (reverse proxy + auto HTTPS).

nodes.label: Satellite Watcher
nodes.rationale: Open-source Web-based Space Situational Awareness (SSA) application. Real-time computation and visualization of LEO satellite positions and trajectories based on TLE data.

nodes.label: Mission Simulation
nodes.rationale: TREA-01 remote sensing mission closed-loop simulation covering task planning, orbit maneuver visualization, imaging simulation, and report export.

nodes.label: Collision Avoidance
nodes.rationale: Emergency maneuver system triggered by debris approach alerts. Generates 3 avoidance plans and executes orbit switching with video playback.

nodes.label: AOI (Area of Interest)
nodes.rationale: Target observation regions for TREA-01 mission. Two AOIs defined: South China Sea (Xisha-Philippines) and Strait of Hormuz.

nodes.label: Chase Cockpit View
nodes.rationale: First-person 'racing' view of TREA-01 with traffic satellites. Accessible via /cockpit route with independent Cesium implementation.

nodes.label: TLE (Two-Line Elements)
nodes.rationale: Satellite orbit data format propagated via SGP4/SDP4 algorithm using satellite.js library. Core data format for all orbit computations.

nodes.label: Maneuver Visualization
nodes.rationale: 5-second orbit transition animation with old orbit fading (gray dashed) and new orbit appearing (cyan glowing solid). TLE auto-updates to drive position propagation switch.

nodes.label: Docker Compose Deployment
nodes.rationale: Multi-service Docker Compose deployment for HK server. Includes PostgreSQL, migration/seed, Next.js app, and Caddy reverse proxy with auto HTTPS.

nodes.label: Zustand Stores
nodes.rationale: Lightweight global state management using Zustand with selector subscriptions. Four stores manage satellites, time, TREA mission, and cinematic playback.

nodes.label: Next.js App Router
nodes.rationale: Next.js 14 App Router framework with SSR, API Routes, and Standalone output. Layout loads Cesium.js CDN script and global styles.

nodes.label: CesiumJS
nodes.rationale: WebGL 3D globe rendering library loaded via CDN (jsdelivr). Used for both main globe view (Entity system) and chase cockpit view (direct Model primitives).

nodes.label: AvoidanceVideoModal
nodes.rationale: Video player for collision avoidance maneuver playback. Pauses Cesium rendering during playback by setting videoPlaying state.

nodes.label: ScanVideoModal
nodes.rationale: Video player for cinematic scan playback. Uses cinematicStore for state management. Plays scan video with cinematic shots configuration.

nodes.label: Cockpit Page Route
nodes.rationale: Route entry for /cockpit. Dynamically imports ChaseCockpit with SSR disabled (ssr: false) since Cesium requires browser environment.

nodes.label: Root Layout
nodes.rationale: Next.js root layout that loads Cesium.js CDN script, global styles, and AudioPlayer. Sets page metadata to '开源太空 - 卫星守望者'.

nodes.label: timeStore
nodes.rationale: Zustand store for time playback control. Default 10x speed. Used by both main globe and chase cockpit for synchronized time simulation.

nodes.label: cinematicStore
nodes.rationale: Zustand store for cinematic playback state. Manages current shot, pause state, and elapsed time for 4-phase mission replay.

nodes.label: satelliteStore
nodes.rationale: Zustand store managing satellite list, selection state, and tracking state for the main globe view.
